Epic Games Store Free Games List 2025

By Fran J. RuizJan 8, 20260 comments
Reddit Facebook X Email
Share
Reddit Facebook X Email

What games were free on the Epic Games Store during 2025? As the Epic Games Store enters 2026, it continues to provide a favorable revenue model where developers earn a larger portion of the proceeds from their games. In addition to hosting exclusive titles, the storefront continues to offer a growing list of free games each week.

2024’s selection on the Epic Games Store featured a diverse array of games, including major AAA titles, unique indie games, and item packs for several free-to-play games. Highlights included Marvel’s Guardians of the Galaxy, A Plague Tale: Innocence, Deus Ex: Mankind Divided, The Outer Worlds: Spacer’s Choice Edition, Thief, Dragon Age Inquisition – Game of the Year Edition, Chivalry 2, The Callisto Protocol, Lego Star Wars: The Skywalker Saga, and The Lord of the Rings: Return to Moria.

Continuing with this tradition, the lineup of free games available on the Epic Games Store in 2025 started with a strong showing in Kingdom Come: Deliverance. This article contains all the titles which were given away in 2025. Some may or may not return to the platform’s free offerings, but it remains to be seen what 2026 has in store for us.

What was the last free game on Epic Games Store in 2025?

  • Chivalry 2 was up for grabs until December 31. It was part of the daily Christmas games that are given out each year.

Since its debut at the end of 2018, the Epic Games Store’s free games list has generally expanded weekly. Notably, in the latter part of December, there are daily giveaways, a trend that returned in 2025.

To access these free titles, set up an EGS account, navigate to the storefront’s section dedicated to free games, and proceed as if making a regular purchase.

You must add the games to your cart, but they are free. However, to claim them, you must add them to your library during their free period, usually a week.

The Epic Games Store’s free games roster is updated every Thursday at 8 AM PT/ 4 PM GMT, though this schedule has been interrupted at times.

Over the years, some games have appeared multiple times on the list. If you happen to miss any, it’s a good idea to keep an eye on the Epic Games Store’s various sales, where they might be available at a discounted price.

Kingdom Come Deliverance

Free on the Epic Games Store: 2nd - 9th January

You’re Henry, the son of a blacksmith. Thrust into a raging civil war, you watch helplessly as invaders storm your village and slaughter your friends and family. Narrowly escaping the brutal attack, you grab your sword to fight back. Avenge the death of your parents and help repel the invading forces in Kingdom Come Deliverance. Perfect, this helps to get everyone ready for Kingdom Come: Deliverance 2, which is releasing in February 2025.

Hell Let Loose

Free on the Epic Games Store: 2nd - 9th January

Join the chaos of war and be a part of the most iconic battles of the Eastern and Western Fronts, including Carentan, Omaha Beach, Stalingrad, Kursk, and more. Hell Let Loose drops you into the action, where you will have to fight across fields, bridges, forests, towns, and more war-torn environments. Lumbering tanks will dominate the battlefield, and crucial supply chains will fuel the frontlines; you are essential to the colossal, combined arms warfare.

Turmoil

Free on the Epic Games Store: 9th - 16th January

Turmoil offers players a tongue-in-cheek take on the simulation genre inspired by the 19th-century oil rush in North America. Get a taste of the rush and rivalry of the time as you earn your way to becoming a successful oil entrepreneur. The town will grow with you as you make money digging up and selling oil.

Lease land at the town auction and search for oil. Build a rig, create an efficient pipe network, and bring up the oil to store it in silos. Sell the oil at the best times to maximize profits. Then, buy essential upgrades in town to cope with rock, gas, and ice. Acquire more town shares than your competitors to become the new mayor.

Escape Academy

Free on the Epic Games Store: 16th - 23rd January

You’ve just arrived at Escape Academy, where promising students train to become the ultimate Escapist. Play over a dozen hand-crafted rooms designed by experienced experts in the field of escape rooms. Experience the entirety of Escape Academy alone in single-player OR through two-player co-operative play. Available in local or online split-screen. Escape Academy was also free on the Epic Games Store in 2024.

Behind the Frame: The Finest Scenery

Free on the Epic Games Store: 23rd - 30th January

Behind the Frame is a vivid, interactive fiction about an aspiring artist on the cusp of finishing the final piece of her gallery submission. A relaxing, eloquent experience that can be played at any pace. Become immersed in a panoramic world filled with resplendent colors, beautiful hand-animated visuals, and a smooth, easy-listening soundtrack. As a passionate artist, seek the missing colors that will bring your paintings to life - all while remembering to take the occasional coffee and breakfast breaks that keep you going. There is more than what meets the eye, for every painting has a story to tell.

Undying

Free on the Epic Games Store: 30th January - 6th February

Caught amid the zombie apocalypse and with time running out, Anling will stop at nothing to ensure her son, Cody, gets to safety in Undying. Enduring countless perils, including the zombie infection that’s beginning to take over her body, not to mention teaching Cody how to survive their harsh new reality.

As Anling and Cody explore the world, they encounter an ensemble of characters who present unique challenges. How they handle each one determines their fate. Some may die, some may live, and some may become staunch allies or even archnemeses. Will humanity truly prevail?

Beyond Blue

Free on the Epic Games Store: 6th February - 13th February

Beyond Blue is a single-player narrative adventure that takes you deep into our planet’s beating blue heart. Set in the near future, Beyond Blue explores the mysteries of our ocean through the eyes of Mirai, a deep-sea explorer and scientist. Become a part of a newly-formed research team using groundbreaking technologies to see, hear, and interact with the ocean in a more meaningful way than has ever been attempted.

Humankind

Free on the Epic Games Store: 6th February - 13th February

Humankind is a historical strategy game where you’ll be re-writing the entire narrative of human history and combining cultures to create a civilization that’s as unique as you are. Combine up to 60 historical cultures as you lead your people from the Ancient to the Modern Age. From humble origins as a Neolithic tribe, transition to the Ancient Era as the Babylonians, become the Classical era Mayans, the Medieval Umayyads, the Early Modern era British, and so on. Each culture will add its own special gameplay layer, leading to near-endless outcomes.

F1 Manager 2024

Free on the Epic Games Store: 13th February - 20th February

For the first time in the F1 series, create your own team to challenge the grid and forge a new legacy. Customise every element of your team from your origin and livery design to logo and racing suits. Recruit the right staff and drivers and negotiate with sponsors for placement on your car.

Garden Story

Free on the Epic Games Store: 20th February - 27th February

Traverse the four seasons in this wholesome world inhabited by quirky fruits and vegetables! As the newest guardian of the Grove, it is your duty to rebuild the village and uncover the story of its hidden past. Complete daily requests to defend, restore, and improve the town. As you progress, you’ll unlock memories that allow Concord to harness the power of their predecessors.

World War Z: Aftermath

Free on the Epic Games Store: 20th February - 27th February

World War Z: Aftermath is the ultimate co-op zombie shooter based on Paramount Pictures’ blockbuster film, and the next evolution of the original hit World War Z that has now captivated over 20 million players. Turn the tide of the zombie apocalypse across consoles and PC with full cross-play. Join up to three friends or play on your own with AI teammates against hordes of ravenous zombies in intense story episodes across new zombie-ravaged locations around the world: Rome, Vatican City and Russia’s Kamchatka peninsula.

Mages of Mystralia

Free on the Epic Games Store: 27th February - 6th March

In Mages of Mystralia, you play as Zia, a young girl who discovers that she has been born with an innate sense of magic. Unfortunately, magic has been banned, so she strikes off to train on her own to gain some control over her powers. On her journey, she meets other exiled mages and, discovers runes with magical properties and realizes that she can combine these runes in millions of different ways to come up with completely new spells.

Them's Fightin' Herds

Free on the Epic Games Store: March 6th - March 13th

Them’s Fightin’ Herds is a 2D fighting game featuring a cast of adorable animals designed by acclaimed cartoon producer Lauren Faust. Beneath the cute and cuddly surface, a serious fighter awaits!

Mortal Shell

Free on the Epic Games Store: March 13th - March 20th

Mortal Shell is a deep action-RPG that tests your sanity and resilience in a shattered world. As the remains of humanity wither and rot, zealous foes fester in the ruins. They spare no mercy, with survival demanding superior awareness, precision and instincts. Track down hidden sanctums of devout followers and discover your true purpose.

Jurassic World Evolution 2

Free on the Epic Games Store: March 20th - March 27th

As a celebration of all things Jurassic, Jurassic World Evolution 2 is a worthy successor to the original. As a park management game, it struggles to find a meaningful focal point. Given Frontier’s expertise in this exact department elsewhere, that’s more than a little disappointing. It is a light, messy sim that acts as a tribute to the prehistoric pandemonium of the Jurassic Park/World series. You can read our full review here.

Cat Quest

Free on the Epic Games Store: March 27 - April 3

Cat Quest is an open world RPG set in the pawsome world of cats! Leap into a grand adventure in purrsuit of the evil Drakoth and your catnapped sister. Explore Felingard’s huge overworld map, risk life and limb delving into dungeons for epic loot, and lend a paw to a furry cast of characters in a flurry of side quests.

Neko Ghost, Jump!

Free on the Epic Games Store: March 27 - April 3

Nekoworld is a peaceful, fun-loving world inhabited by the Neko people. One day, on Nekoman’s wedding day, Space Dog Pirates invade and abduct all of Nekoman’s friends and family. It’s up to you to help him rescue his bride-to-be and everyone else as well.

Cat Quest 2

Free on the Epic Games Store: April 3 - April 10

Cat Quest 2 is a 2D open-world action-RPG set in a fantasy realm of cats and dogs. Under threat from a continuing war between the cats of Felingard and the advancing dogs of the Lupus Empire, CAT QUEST II tells the tail of two kings, brought together against their will, on a journey of paw-some discovery to reclaim their thrones.

River City Girls

Free on the Epic Games Store: April 10 - April 17

There’s trouble once again on the mean streets of River City, but this time the boys are in over their heads! In this all-new entry in the legendary beat-‘em-up series, hot-blooded heroes Kunio and Riki have been captured, leaving it to their hard-hitting girlfriends, Kyoko and Misako, to serve up some payback.

Botanicula

Free on the Epic Games Store: April 17 - April 24

Botanicula is a humor-filled adventure game about five friends, little tree creatures, who set out on a journey to save the last seed from their home tree, which is infested by evil parasites.

Chuchel

Free on the Epic Games Store: April 24 - May 1

Chuchel is a comedy adventure game from the creators of Machinarium, Botanicula and Samorost. Join the hairy hero Chuchel and his rival Kekel as they will be facing numerous puzzles and challenges in their quest to retrieve the precious cherry.

Super Space Club

Free on the Epic Games Store: May 1 - May 8

Super Space Club is a lo-fi arcade space shooter to chill to. Defend a vibrant galaxy as a club of misfit heroes and battle endless waves of spacecrafts to the tune of atmospheric beats. Outlast your enemies and vibe to the rhythm of the stars.

LEGO Star Wars: The Skywalker Saga

Free on the Epic Games Store: May 4

Play through all nine Skywalker saga films. With over 300 playable characters, over 100 vehicles, and 23 planets to explore, a galaxy far, far away has never been more fun! It’s free for 24 hours, so be quick!

Deadtime Defenders

Free on the Epic Games Store: May 8 - May 15

Deadtime Defenders is an action-packed looter shooter with RPG elements. A mysterious portal has unleashed chaos from alternate dimensions - and you’re humanity’s last line of defence. Go on missions looking for epic loot and eliminating enemies before returning to HQ to rearm, debrief, and prepare for the next run.

Touch Type Tale

Free on the Epic Games Store: May 8 - May 15

Touch Type Tale is a real-time strategy game with a typing twist, featuring a story rich campaign and online competitive play that will delight even the most hardened RTS veterans.

Dead Island 2

Free on the Epic Games Store: May 15 - May 22

Dead Island 2 is about a deadly virus spreading across Los Angeles, turning inhabitants into zombies. Bitten, infected, but more than just immune, uncover the truth behind the outbreak and discover who -or what- you are.

Happy Game

Free on the Epic Games Store: May 15 - May 22

A little boy falls asleep to a horrible nightmare. Can you make him happy again? Play Happy Game and find out.

Sifu

Free on the Epic Games Store: May 22 - May 29

Sifu is a realistic third-person brawler with tight Kung Fu combat mechanics and cinematic martial arts action embarking you on a path for revenge.

Gigapocalypse

Free on the Epic Games Store: May 22 - May 29

Become a customizable giant monster with manifold skills in Gigapocalypse, inspired by classical Kaijū movies such as “Godzilla” and “King Kong” and the game classic “Rampage”.

Deliver At All Costs

Free on the Epic Games Store: May 22 - May 29

Deliver At All Costs is a thrilling action game where destruction, absurdity, and intrigue collide! Join Winston Green, a down-on-his-luck courier with a fiery temper and a mysterious past — as he delivers highly unconventional cargo, leaving a trail of havoc and chaos behind him.

Tiny Tina's Wonderlands

Free on the Epic Games Store: May 29 - June 5

Embark on an epic adventure full of whimsy, wonder, and high-powered weaponry in Tiny Tina’s Wonderlands! Bullets, magic, and broadswords collide across this chaotic fantasy world brought to life by the unpredictable Tiny Tina. Roll your own multiclass hero and loot, shoot, slash, and cast your way through outlandish monsters and loot-filled dungeons on a quest to stop the tyrannical Dragon Lord.

Limbo

Free on the Epic Games Store: May 29 - June 5

Limbo is an award-winning indie adventure, critically acclaimed for its captivating puzzle design and immersive sound and visuals. Its dark, misty spaces and haunting narrative will stay with you forever.

Deathloop

Free on the Epic Games Store: June 5 - June 12

Deathloop is a next-gen first-person shooter from Arkane Lyon, the award-winning studio behind Dishonored. In DEATHLOOP, two rival assassins are trapped in a mysterious time loop on the island of Blackreef, doomed to repeat the same day for eternity.

Ogu and the Secret Forest

Free on the Epic Games Store: June 5 - June 12

Ogu and the Secret Forest is a 2D adventure game with hand-drawn characters and various types of puzzles. Befriend bouncy characters and defeat strange creatures to unravel the mystery of the charming world.

Two Point Hospital

Free on the Epic Games Store: June 12 - June 19

Design stunning hospitals, cure peculiar illnesses, and manage troublesome staff as you spread your budding healthcare organisation across Two Point County.

The Operator

Free on the Epic Games Store: June 19 - June 26

Time to clear your head, work through your hangover, and start your first day as an Operator. There are plenty of cases to solve. Assist our field agents using your computer console and ingenuity to bring criminals to justice. Ready to make the world a better place?

Sable

Free on the Epic Games Store: June 26 - July 3

Embark on a unique and unforgettable journey and guide Sable through her Gliding; a rite of passage that will take her across vast deserts and mesmerizing landscapes, capped by the remains of spaceships and ancient wonders.

Backpack Hero

Free on the Epic Games Store: July 3 - July 10

Backpack Hero is a twist on your standard deck-building roguelike. It isn’t just about what you carry, but how you organize the items within your bag! Their placement has a huge impact on their performance. Find them the right spot in your backpack to increase their power! Explore ancient dungeons, caves, swamps, and more! Meet colorful friends and fight deadly foes! Don’t get lost!

Figment

Free on the Epic Games Store: July 3 - July 10

A musical action-adventure set in the recesses of the human mind… Welcome to the world of Figment. A strange and surreal world; a place filled with our deepest thoughts, urges and memories, populated by the many voices we hear in our heads.

Figment 2: Creed Valley

Free on the Epic Games Store: July 10 - July 17

Figment 2: Creed Valley is an action-adventure game set in the human mind. Nightmares are spreading chaos and have overrun once-peaceful lands. Join Dusty, The Mind’s courage, as you make your way through puzzles, musical boss fights and unique environments.

Sky Racket

Free on the Epic Games Store: July 10 - July 17

Sky Racket is a game that mixes two classic genres from the Arcade era: Shoot ‘em up and Brick Breakers. In a world where you are unable to attack, using your racket to strike enemy bullets back at them is your only option! Bounce bullets back at your foes and save the galaxy!

Sid Meier’s Civilization VI: Platinum Edition

Free on the Epic Games Store: July 17 - July 24

Sid Meier’s Civilization VI: Platinum Edition is the perfect entry point for PC gamers who have yet to experience the addictive gameplay that has made Civilization one of the greatest game series of all time.

Legion TD 2

Free on the Epic Games Store: July 24 - July 31

An infinitely replayable multiplayer and single-player tower defense. Defend against waves of enemies and destroy the enemy’s king before they destroy yours. Legion TD 2 is a one-of-a-kind game of tactics, teamwork, and prediction. Party as 1-8 players.

Keylocker

Free on the Epic Games Store: July 31- August 7

Keylocker is a Cyberpunk turn-based rhythm JRPG. As the electric singer, B0B0, you’ll choose your class, master a challenging combat system, and shake the foundations of Saturnite society in rhythm-game style!

Pilgrims

Free on the Epic Games Store: July 31- August 7

Pilgrims is a playful adventure game, created by the team behind Machinarium and Samorost. Roam the land as you please and make new friends, share a laugh with your fellow travelers and help them complete their little stories, your way. How many different solutions can you find?

112 Operator

Free on the Epic Games Store: August 7 - August 14

112 Operator allows you to manage emergency services in any city in the world! Dispatch units, take calls and face situations caused by weather, traffic or changing seasons. Help the city survive escalating events like riots, organized crime, terrorist attacks, cataclysms, natural disasters, and many more!

Road Redemption

Free on the Epic Games Store: August 7 - August 14

Road Redemption is an action racing game where you lead your motorcycle gang on an epic journey across the country in a brutal driving combat adventure, taking heavy inspiration from series such as Road Rash and Motorstorm.

Hidden Folks

Free on the Epic Games Store: August 14 - August 21

Search for Hidden Folks in hand-drawn, interactive, miniature landscapes. Unfurl tent flaps, cut through bushes, slam doors, and poke some crocodiles! A strip of targets shows you what to look for. Click on a target for a hint, and find enough to unlock the next area.

Totally Reliable Delivery Service

Free on the Epic Games Store: August 14 - August 21

Delivery Attempted. Totally Reliable Delivery Service is a ragdoll physics simulation about terrible package delivery couriers. Work together using odd machinery, useful gadgets, and the wonders of physics to reliably deliver packages to their destination.

Kamaeru: A Frog Refuge

Free on the Epic Games Store: August 21 - August 28

Foster a sanctuary for frogs and restore the biodiversity of the wetlands in Kamaeru, a cozy frog collecting game, where you take pictures of frogs, play mini-games and decorate your habitat. Hop right to it!

Strange Horticulture

Free on the Epic Games Store: August 21 - August 28

An occult puzzle game in which you play as the proprietor of a local plant store. Find and identify new plants, pet your cat, speak to a coven, or join a cult. Use your collection of powerful plants to influence the story and unravel Undermere’s dark mysteries.

Make Way

Free on the Epic Games Store: August 29 - September 5

Speed around loops, dart through train crossings, drift around helter skelters, and unleash wacky weaponry in this modern take on classic top-down multiplayer racing games. The twist? You build the track.

Machinarium

Free on the Epic Games Store: August 29 - September 5

A little robot who’s been thrown out to the scrap yard behind the city must return and confront the Black Cap Brotherhood and save his robot-girl friend.

Monument Valley

Free on the Epic Games Store: September 4 - September 11

Embark on a journey of forgiveness through impossible environments and illusionary puzzles. Experience this meditative and calming puzzle game by manipulating monuments and creating evolving paths to explore new, surreal, and mysterious worlds.

The Battle of Polytopia

Free on the Epic Games Store: September 11 - September 18

This is an award-winning strategy game about controlling the map, fighting enemy tribes, discovering new lands, and mastering new technologies. You take on the role of the ruler of a tribe and attempt to build a civilization in a turn-based competition with the other tribes.

Monument Valley 2

Free on the Epic Games Store: September 11 - September 18

In this meditative and calming puzzle game, follow the heart-warming story of Ro in her journey through motherhood. Rediscover independence through manipulating monuments and evolving paths to explore new, surreal, and mysterious worlds.

Ghostrunner 2

Free on the Epic Games Store: September 11 - September 18

Blood will run in the highly anticipated hardcore FPP slasher set one year after the events of Ghostrunner. Adventure through a post-apocalyptic cyberpunk future that takes place after the fall of the Keymaster, a tyrant who ruled over Dharma Tower, the last refuge of mankind. Jack is back to take on the violent AI cult that has assembled outside Dharma Tower and shape the future of humanity.

Project Winter

Free on the Epic Games Store: September 19 - September 26

In Project Winter, survival is just the beginning. Work with your friends to escape the icy wilderness, but don’t get too comfortable. Traitors lurk among you, ready to lie, sabotage, and turn even the closest of friends against each other. Who will you trust?

Samorost 2

Free on the Epic Games Store: September 19 - September 26

Samorost 2 tells a surreal story of a space gnome whose dog just got kidnapped by mischievous aliens. Set out on a short expedition to rescue the pup, deal with curious strangers and relax to the soothing music by Tomáš “Floex” Dvořák.

Eastern Exorcist

Free on the Epic Games Store: September 26 - October 3

Eastern Exorcist is a stunning 2D side-scrolling action RPG set in a fictitious eastern world with the infestation of vicious demon monsters. Play as a skilled exorcist against chaotic evil to fight your way through the brutal world.

Jorel’s Brother and The Most Important Game of the Galaxy

Free on the Epic Games Store: September 26 - October 2

Jorel’s Brother and The Most Important Game of the Galaxy is a point-and-click adventure about an eight-year-old boy who lives with his eccentric family in the shadow of Jorel, his handsome and popular brother. Based on the award-winning Brazilian animation “Jorel’s Brother”.

Nightingale

Free on the Epic Games Store: October 2 - October 9

Nightingale is a first-person, PVE, open-world survival crafting game played solo or cooperatively with friends. Build, craft, fight and explore as you venture through mystical portals into a variety of amazing and fantastical realms.

Gravity Circuit

Free on the Epic Games Store: October 9 - October 16

Gravity Circuit is a flashy and action-packed 2D platformer in the spirit of our favorite ancient classics. It follows Kai, a lone operative war hero “who harnesses the mysterious powers of the Gravity Circuit” as he goes on an adventure in a futuristic world inhabited by sentient robots.

Amnesia: The Bunker

Free on the Epic Games Store: October 16 - October 23

Amnesia: The Bunker is the last installment in the long-running first-person horror series. After being “left all alone in a desolate WW1 bunker with only one bullet remaining in the barrel,” the player must face the oppressing terrors in the dark while being chased by a “relentless, AI-driven monster.” Can you brave this one?

Samorost 3

Free on the Epic Games Store: October 16 - October 23

Samorost 3 follows “a curious space gnome who uses the powers of a magic flute to travel across the cosmos in search of its mysterious origins.” The journey spans nine unique alien worlds that are full of colorful challenges, puzzles, creatures, and surprises to discover. Needless to say, it’s a near-perfect respite after Amnesia: The Bunker’s horrors.

Fear the Spotlight

Free on the Epic Games Store: October 23 - October 30

In Fear the Spotlight, players must sneak into school after hours with Vivian and Amy, survive a séance gone wrong, solve puzzles, and, as the title suggests, stay out of the spotlight. Described as “a creepy love letter to classic 90s horror experiences,” it leans more towards the narrative side of things.

Bendy and the Ink Machine

Free on the Epic Games Store: October 30 - November 6

Bendy and the Ink Machine takes players into the “abandoned animation workshop of Joey Drew Studios, a studio with a dark history.” It’s a puzzle action horror game that aims to “forever ruin your childhood love of cartoons.” Considering the series’ endurance since this game launched in 2017, we’re inclined to say it succeeded.

Five Nights at Freddy’s: Into the Pit

Free on the Epic Games Store: October 30 - November 6

Released in 2024, Five Nights at Freddy’s: Into the Pit puts aside the familiar gameplay of other FNAF entries to commit to retro-inspired 2D adventure design and structure. “Travel between time periods to solve puzzles, gather clues, and outrun the threat relentlessly pursuing you,” all while learning more about the dense FNAF lore and history.

Felix the Reaper

Free on the Epic Games Store: November 6 - November 13

Felix the Reaper is a challenging and rigid 3D puzzle game that’s all about bringing humans into deadly situations… but with extra style. You are Felix, the ever-dancing bringer of death, who just so happens to be dangerously in love with Life. He must stick to the shadows, control them to reach his targets, and, of course, make sure they die.

ScourgeBringer

Free on the Epic Games Store: November 13 - November 20

ScourgeBringer is a fast-paced roguelite that’s heavy on platforming and demands quick reflexes. You play as the warrior Kyhra as she explores the unknown and slashes her way through “ancient machines guarding the seal of her past, and maybe the redemption of humanity.” It’s an overlooked (and extremely colorful) roguelite set in a post-apocalypse that’s totally worth your attention and time.

Songs of Silence

Free on the Epic Games Store: November 13 - November 20

Songs of Silence is one of the most gorgeous turn-based strategy games currently available. In it, you lead armies, rebuild fallen kingdoms, and rise to greatness across eight campaign maps. “Embark on an epic journey of strategy in an Art Nouveau-inspired fantasy world. Fight intense battles and uncover a captivating story.”

Zero Hour

Free on the Epic Games Store: November 13 - November 20

Zero Hour is a modern tactical FPS with online team-based game play which takes place in a variety of fictional locations set across Bangladesh. “Join forces with up to 10 players in intense cooperative missions, or go solo with up to 9 AI squad mates. Experience hostage rescue and bomb defusal missions that require calculated strategies in the dynamic 5v5 PvP mode.”

Godzilla Voxel Wars

Free on the Epic Games Store: November 20 - November 27

Godzilla Voxel Wars is a turn-based strategy game that plays out like a puzzle and takes place on 8x8 grids. Players control classic Toho monsters and try to save the world from a huge invasion with Fungoids as the main opposing force. Reviews for this one were surprisingly positive despite its off-beat pitch and the lack of kaiju-centric action you’d expect from the IP.

Zoeti

Free on the Epic Games Store: November 20 - November 27

Zoeti has been part of Epic’s free offerings before, and it’s now returning with its turn-based roguelite battles built around cards and synergies. It also has a decent amount of narrative elements that add depth to each run, and different characters also shake things up outside the deck builds.

Universe for Sale

Free on the Epic Games Store: November 27 - December 4

Universe for Sale is a unique take on visual novels and point-and-click adventures. The setting? A space station “nestled in the clouds of Jupiter.” The narrative hook? A young woman who can apparently create entire universes in the palm of her hand. It sounds strange, but the best narrative-oriented video games dare to think outside the box. Hand-drawn art and animations only help seal an already enticing pitch here.

The Darkside Detective

Free on the Epic Games Store: December 4 - December 11

The Darkside Detective conjures up comedy and intrigue through a point-and-click adventure made up of nine “micro cases” which takes the player around Twin Lakes City. “Grab your trench coat, tune your sixth sense and join the Darkside Division as they investigate the outright bizarre, the downright dangerous and the confusing cases of Twin Lakes. Flesh-hungry tentacles, mafian zombies, and the occasional missing sock are no match for The Darkside Detective.” The pixel art is lovely too. Perfect for a cold December evening, we think.

The Jackbox Party Pack 4

Free on the Epic Games Store: December 4 - December 11

The Jackbox Party Pack 4 continues the famous party game franchise with a selection of games and modes that could also fuel an entire December evening of group-oriented fun. Answer questions, twist your friends’ comments, and doodle your way to the top. Phones and tablets are supported as controllers, so there’s no excuse to join this party!

Looking for Epic Game Store sale dates? You can find the complete list for 2025 right here.

Hogwarts Legacy

Free on the Epic Games Store: December 11 - December 18

WB Games and Avalanche Software’s Hogwarts Legacy has been revealed to be the special Game Awards-promoted title that Epic is giving away ahead of Christmas. Those coming in fresh should know it’s a massive open-world action-RPG set before the events of the Harry Potter books and movies.

The adventure isn’t limited to Hogwarts, as players can also explore the surrounding areas while tackling all sorts of small and mid-sized activities on top of the central questline. It’s the average modern open-world experience, but Potter-themed. Like it or not, Hogwarts Legacy became a mainstream hit in 2023, so this giveaway should end up being one of Epic’s biggest yet.

Jotunnslayer: Hordes of Hel

Free on the Epic Games Store: December 18 - December 19

Jotunnslayer: Hordes of Hel is one of the better roguelite horde-survivor (inspired by Vampire Survivors) games we’ve had recently, and after hitting 1.0 this year, Epic is now giving it away. Quite the Christmas present if you ask us.

The main appeal comes from its higher fidelity graphics and the use of Norse mythology. In-run missions, a varied roster of characters, and a combo system which puts it above most of its peers are only a handful of reasons why you spend time with this one… as long as you like filling the screen with FX and carnage.

Eternights

Free on the Epic Games Store: December 19 - December 20

Eternights is a dating action game, blending a love story with adrenaline-driven combat as you make the most out of life during the apocalypse. Scavenge for supplies, explore dungeons… and go on dates!

One day, something, or someone, has turned humans into dangerous monsters. All that interests them now is violence and power. They are what stand between you, a cure, and the world you want. Most importantly? You’re fighting for more than just your own survival – you are fighting for those you love.

Blood West

Free on the Epic Games Store: December 20 - December 21

Blood West is an immersive stealth FPS. Become the Undead Gunslinger, doomed to roam the barren lands until he manages to purge their curse, freeing his soul. 3 varied scenarios, perk-based progression, and 20+ hours of gameplay await you!

Blood West is a stealth FPS inspired by the genre classics such as the Thief series (whose fans will be happy to hear the voice of Stephen Russell, the actor voicing the master-thief Garrett, returning here as the protagonist), S.T.A.L.K.E.R. games, or - from the contemporary catalog - Hunt: Showdown. The gameplay rewards the careful approach: scouting the area, stalking your enemies, and striking from the shadows. Can you figure out a way to clear a fort full of ghouls and monsters without raising an alarm?

Sorry We’re Closed

Free on the Epic Games Store: December 21 - December 22

Sorry We’re Closed is a story-driven survival horror game about demons, angels and what happens when both sides collide. A mix of fixed-camera exploration and arcade-style shooting where Michelle must use her Third Eye to see between worlds, uncover secrets and solve puzzles.

Follow the final days of Michelle as she battles to break the curse placed on her by a powerful archdemon looking for love. Help (or hinder!) the lives of the curious residents in Michelle’s bustling London borough as she pursues freedom from her own untimely demise.

Michelle’s time is split between the perilous demon world and mingling with the locals on her residential street. Everyone is battling their own inner demons and through Michelle you can help guide them. Multiple endings are available through RPG-style dialogue interactions with the extravagant cast.

Paradise Killer

Free on the Epic Games Store: December 22 - December 23

Paradise Killer puts a spin on what you’d normally expect from a detective game by having its action set in “a world outside reality,” where the island of Paradise regenerates every few millennia.

When the council charged with the whole process of rebirth is murdered, we step in to solve the case and discover the culprit. Blending investigative gameplay with puzzle elements, the title sees us encountering plenty of quirky characters, studying bizarre relics, and exploring a place quite unlike any other as we search for the truth.

Bloodstained: Ritual of the Night

Free on the Epic Games Store: December 23 - December 24

If your holidays require a dose of gothic dark fantasy, Bloodstained: Ritual of the Night has got you covered. A spiritual successor to the old Castlevania games from none other than Koji Igarashi himself, the title blends side-scrolling action-RPG with exploration and puzzle-solving.

There’s a sizeable, dark, mysterious castle to explore alongside a plethora of foes to defeat while making your way to the alchemist who cursed you. If you were unsure which metroidvania to start after completing Silksong, you can’t go wrong with this Epic Games Store freebie.

The Callisto Protocol

Free on the Epic Games Store: December 24 - December 25

Death and dismemberment fall well within the spirit of the season and The Callisto Protocol delivers plenty of both. The sci-fi third-person survival horror follows Jacob Lee as he fights to escape Black Iron Prison after a strange outbreak unleashes bloodthirsty monsters on Jupiter’s dead moon.

At its core, the title is a more melee-focused take on the brand of horror established by Dead Space. Retaining the industrial aesthetic and love for gore of the game that inspired it, The Callisto Protocol’s approach to combat set it apart but also proved quite divisive. If you’ve been on the fence about jumping in, there’s really no better time to grab it than now.

Disco Elysium: The Final Cut

Free on the Epic Games Store: December 25 - December 26

Disco Elysium is a groundbreaking role playing game. You’re a detective with a unique skill system at your disposal. Interrogate unforgettable characters, crack murders or take bribes. Become a hero or an absolute disaster of a human being.

Face the reality of your worldview as your political compass leads you down new paths. Discover more citizens, a whole extra area, and monumental sights as you leave an even bigger mark on the world by chasing your dreams. Intimidate, sweet-talk, resort to violence, write poetry, sing karaoke, dance like a beast or solve the meaning of life. Disco Elysium is the most faithful representation of desktop role playing ever attempted in video games.

We Were Here Together

Free on the Epic Games Store: December 26 - December 27

We Were Here Together is a puzzle solving adventure in which you and a partner must prove you can communicate and work together to escape Castle Rock.

It all begins with an emergency flare lighting up the sky and a distress call waking you from uneasy dreams. Your fellow Antarctic explorers are in trouble, and the two of you left at base camp must work together to launch a rescue mission. If only you knew what you were getting into…

From the research base camp you’ll need to figure out a way to get to the source of the distress flare. Once you’re through the frozen Antarctic wastes, you’ll find yourselves separated inside a medieval castle, facing puzzles, secrets, and dangers! You and your partner start out with nothing but your wits and a walkie-talkie each. Observation, smart communication and teamwork will be the only way to escape from the sinister Castle Rock.

Cassette Beasts

Free on the Epic Games Store: December 27 - December 28

Cassette Beasts is all about collecting awesome monsters to use during turn-based battles. It’s an open-world RPG, now with online multiplayer mode to boot. Combine any two monster forms using Cassette Beasts’ Fusion System to create unique and powerful new ones!

Welcome to New Wirral, a remote island inhabited by strange creatures you’ve only dreamed of, nightmares you hopefully haven’t, and a cast of brave folks who use cassette tapes to transform for battle. To find a way home you’ll need to explore every inch of the island, and record monsters to your trusty cassette tapes to gain their abilities!

SKALD: Against the Black Priory

Free on the Epic Games Store: December 28 - December 29

SKALD: Against the Black Priory is a retro-style party-based RPG set in a grim-dark fantasy world of tragic heroes, violent deaths and Lovecraftian horror. Take a chance and roll the dice as you embark on a compelling story filled with deadly creatures, branching story and tactical, turn-based combat.

You drag yourself from the black tides, across the corpses of drowned men, and onto the unwelcoming, craggy shoreline. Gulls cry overhead and the stink of seaweed fills your nose. By some miracle you have made it to Idra. It will take all your skill to survive and unravel the eldritch mysteries of the Black Priory

Viewfinder

Free on the Epic Games Store: December 29 - December 30

Challenge perception, redefine reality, and reshape the world around you with an instant camera. Viewfinder is a new single player game offering gamers hours of interesting and fun experiences while uncovering the mysteries left behind.

Viewfinder is a mind-bending first person adventure game in which you can bring pictures to life by placing them into the world.

Trine Classic Collection

Free on the Epic Games Store: December 30 - December 31

Experience the magic of the puzzle-platforming Trine series with Trine Classic Collection. Includes four titles: Trine Enchanted Edition, Trine 2: Complete Story, Trine 3: Artifacts of Power and Trine 4: Definitive Edition.

Join Amadeus the Wizard, Pontius the Knight, and Zoya the Thief on a journey across a forsaken and ruined kingdom. Bound to a mysterious artifact called Trine, the three unlikely heroes use their unique skills to battle the undead, navigate treacherous environments, and solve challenging physics-based puzzles across a collection of perilous quests. Through the first three titles, the protagonists come to discover, understand, and seek to control the powers bestowed upon them by Trine.

The fourth entry to the puzzle-platforming series returns to Trine’s beloved 2.5D roots. Discover the mysterious Prince Selius, a troubled young wizard whose dark dreams have materialized to wreak havoc in reality. It is up to the band of heroes to resolve the situation before the prince’s magical turmoil consumes the world in its shadows.

Chivalry 2

Free on the Epic Games Store: December 31 - January 1

Chivalry 2 is a multiplayer first person slasher inspired by epic medieval movie battles. Players are thrust into the action of every iconic moment of the era - from clashing swords, to storms of flaming arrows, to sprawling castle sieges and more.

Dominate massive, 64-player battlefields. Catapults tear the earth apart as you lay siege to castles, set fire to villages and slaughter filthy peasants in the return of Team Objective maps.
